class_id: a per-document check reads evidence from a per-IPO row that the IPO's next extraction overwrites
feature: any nightly check whose population is DOCUMENTS (one verdict per offer document) but whose evidence is joined from a table keyed per IPO and step (one row per IPO, rewritten by every later run of that step on any of the IPO's documents)
symptom: the check judges document A on the evidence written by whichever document of the same IPO ran the step LAST. When a later document of another type (a price band advertisement, a corrigendum, an anchor report) re-runs the step and carries none of the fields A's verdict needs, A reads as 'no value and no recorded reason' although A's own run recorded one. The verdict is then a FAIL that no fix to A's reader can clear, and a reader gap and an overwritten row look identical in the report.
first_seen: 2026-10-03 -- issuer_ratio_yield (#1179) on staging, probe docs/design/probes/item46-r2-ratio-evidence.mjs (read-only). The floor joins documents to ipo_pipeline_steps ON ipo_id AND step_id = 'E9' (unique per IPO and step). For 3 of the 5 documents reported 'no current_ratio and no recorded reason' the IPO's one E9 row carries no ratioReasons at all, and its input_ref (sha256 of the input file) equals the sha256 of a PRICE BAND ADVERTISEMENT extracted after the RHP, not of the RHP: asset-reconstruction-company-india-ltd RHP cf004ed6, E9 written by PRICE_BAND_AD 982f4b40; esds-software-solution-ltd RHP edc03a70, E9 by PRICE_BAND_AD 55af1196; madhur-knit-crafts-ltd RHP fbeff8c6, E9 by PRICE_BAND_AD 79502de8 (a price band ad emits no ratio fields, so the step recorder writes no ratioReasons). The other two now carry reasons from a later run (paramount-syntex-ltd ratio_heading_count_differs_from_value_count, vishal-nirmiti-ltd ratio_row_not_in_note), i.e. their verdict also moves with whichever run wrote last.
fix_prs: none yet (item 46 round 2 records the class; the reader fixes in that PR do not touch it). Structural remedy (run-discipline B8): record the ratio reasons per DOCUMENT (the document's own field receipts / fetch-state row) and judge each document on its own record, instead of on the IPO's single E9 row
detection_check: none: the affected check (issuer_ratio_yield) is itself the blind one; until the evidence is per document, its 'no recorded reason' rows are not reader gaps and must be read with the probe above before any reader work is planned on them
